metadataAttributes.danluu_summary: A schema migration produced enough load that Percona Replication Manager failed the MySQL master over to a node with a cold InnoDB buffer pool, which then failed back. Disabling Pacemaker `maintenance-mode` the next day triggered a Pacemaker segfault that produced a partition; two simultaneous master elections occurred and the elected primary was the stale node, allowing 7 minutes of data drift in which 16 private repositories were briefly routed to the wrong owners.
